ValidationRule.description: You cannot mark an SOW as Executed unless Legal and Finance have both reviewed it and SOW is delivered.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISCHANGED(SOW_Executed__c), ISCHANGED(Legal_Reviewed__c), ISCHANGED(Finance_Reviewed__c), ISCHANGED(SOW_Delivered__c) ), SOW_Executed__c = TRUE, OR( Legal_Reviewed__c = FALSE, Finance_Reviewed__c = FALSE, SOW_Delivered__c = FALSE ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The SOW cannot be marked as Executed until it has been reviewed by both Legal and Finance, and is delivered.
